title: Coastal Gem | KEY.co
description_expanded: Located just steps from the beach and a short stroll to the Tide Pools, this updated condo offers a perfect blend of coastal charm and village convenience. Set in a sought-after beachfront community, this bright and airy retreat features tasteful furnishings, a spacious living room with coastal chic décor, and a lovely patio where ocean breezes flow freely. The living room’s smart TV, cozy electric fireplace, and sofa bed ensure comfort and relaxation, making it an ideal space for both family time and quiet evenings in. The kitchen is fully updated, equipped with modern appliances and everything needed to prepare meals of any kind, from a casual lunch to a Thanksgiving feast. The condo's serene bedroom offers a queen bed, ample closet space, and a ceiling fan for added comfort. For added convenience, there is a washer and dryer in the unit, with additional laundry facilities in the building for larger loads. Outside, a spacious courtyard invites you to relax with plenty of seating and a BBQ area, perfect for enjoying the fresh air and sunny afternoons. With a reserved underground parking spot and easy walking access to nearby restaurants, boutiques, and gyms, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and seaside living.
